provenance: Unchanged self-authored programs executed in the original locally installed G1 15751 firmware. Returned admission/result/complete target pixel controls. Source/font/vendor bytes not bundled; no hardware verification claim.

cases.name: dest3
cases.source: EXPORT BOUND0() BEGIN DIMGROB_P(G1,3,3,#A1B2C3h); PIXON_P(G1,1,1,#123456h); DIMGROB_P(G2,5,5,#112233h); LOCAL ok:=1,r:=0,x,y,p:={}; IFERR r:=BLIT_P(G2,0,0,3,G1); THEN ok:=0; END; FOR y FROM 0 TO 4 DO FOR x FROM 0 TO 4 DO p:=CONCAT(p,{B→R(GETPIX_P(G2,x,y))}); END; END; RETURN {ok,r,p}; END;
